description: Project compound returns for a USDC deposit into any ACCRUE vault or model portfolio over a given holding period. Uses live APY data and applies the ACCRUE platform fee, which is charged on PRINCIPAL (0.25%/yr standalone, 0.50%/yr managed falling to 0.25% above $1M) and never on yield. Returns gross yield, platform fee, net yield and final balance. Because the fee is on principal, net yield can be negative over a short horizon — net_is_negative flags that. Use this when the user asks "how much would I earn" or "what would my $X grow to".

target_id.description: Optional vault ID or portfolio ID. If omitted, projects across all vaults and portfolios.

name: calculate_yield
